name: ShipperDocumentHub
tagline: Every BOL, POD, invoice and certificate of every shipment – requested, chased, verified and shared with the customer in one hub.
description: Complete customer document hub for forwarders, 3PLs and carriers: documents per shipment, required types per transport mode, completeness matrix with one-click requests for what is missing, request → with carrier → received → verified → published workflow with corrections and new versions, POD clock after delivery, invoice-needs-POD rule, overdue invoice and certificate expiry reminders, due-dates agenda, document packs, customer role for a self-service portal, CSV and Power Fx outputs and events – for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Request → with carrier → received → verified → published
Overdue invoice and certificate expiry reminders
Customer role with account scoping and problem reports
